chapter: Medicine show, hoboing and train songs
title: Casey Jones
summary: Allen suggests Steamboat Bill, but Nash remembers some of Casey Jones and sings a fragment.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: Let's see. What about Steamboat Bill? Do you remember much of that?
Steamboat Bill? I think I remember some of Casey Jones.
All right. Well we'll try Casey Jones.

A case he put on for that green old hill. A 41 striking line in the face. The switchman knew that by the engine moan. The man at the trolley was Casey Jones. Casey Jones. I got another popper. Casey Jones. On the Salt Lake line. Casey Jones. I got another popper. I got another popper. On the Salt Lake line. Casey Jones. I got another popper to softly learn.
